purpose: Acceptance-test specifications for future implementation. These are not claims that the user software has been tested.

tests.name: Causal higher-timeframe features
tests.scenario: A decision occurs at 10:05 while its hourly bar ends at 11:00.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject use of the completed 11:00 value; only available values may enter the signal.

tests.name: Pivot confirmation
tests.scenario: A pivot at bar t requires three later bars for confirmation.
tests.expected_behavior: The earliest signal is after those later bars become available, not backdated to t.

tests.name: Training-only preprocessing
tests.scenario: A held-out period has different mean and variance.
tests.expected_behavior: Fit scaling and imputation only on training data; preserve fitted parameters in the model record.

tests.name: Overlapping-label purge
tests.scenario: A training label's outcome interval overlaps the validation period.
tests.expected_behavior: Remove or appropriately separate the contaminated training observation under the declared split policy.

tests.name: Holdout reuse
tests.scenario: A developer changes parameters after seeing final holdout returns.
tests.expected_behavior: Mark the holdout consumed and require new independent evaluation before performance claims.

tests.name: Point-in-time universe
tests.scenario: A failed/delisted asset was tradable during the test.
tests.expected_behavior: Retain it if its historical data meets declared quality rules; log any missing-data exclusion.

tests.name: Corporate-action scale
tests.scenario: A stock undergoes a two-for-one split.
tests.expected_behavior: Adjust position quantity and research series consistently; simulate execution at the actual historical price scale.

tests.name: Book sequence gap
tests.scenario: A depth sequence number is missing.
tests.expected_behavior: Invalidate the book and block new exposure until documented recovery completes.

tests.name: Stale quote
tests.scenario: A quote exceeds the approved age threshold.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject new price-sensitive orders and record the reason.

tests.name: Trade-side semantics
tests.scenario: A venue marks trades by maker side.
tests.expected_behavior: Map correctly before computing aggressor delta; a buy maker implies a sell aggressor under that convention.

tests.name: Zero-volume VWAP
tests.scenario: A session contains no eligible trades.
tests.expected_behavior: Return unavailable with a reason; do not divide by zero or carry an undocumented value.

tests.name: Indicator warm-up
tests.scenario: Live history is shorter than the research warm-up.
tests.expected_behavior: Block the affected strategy or apply the explicitly tested warm-up policy.

tests.name: Tick rounding
tests.scenario: A proposed price lies between valid price ticks.
tests.expected_behavior: Round by the documented side/order policy without violating a price cap; reject if no compliant value exists.

tests.name: Minimum notional conflict
tests.scenario: Risk-approved size falls below venue minimum notional.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject; do not silently increase size beyond risk approval.

tests.name: Stop-sizing example
tests.scenario: Equity=10000, risk_fraction=0.0025, entry=100, stop=99.50, unit_cost=0.10, multiplier=1, lot=1.
tests.expected_behavior: Quantity is 41 before other caps; modeled planned loss is 24.60.

tests.name: Invalid stop direction
tests.scenario: A long order has a stop above entry under a protective-stop specification.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject the inconsistent intent.

tests.name: Inverse-contract PnL
tests.scenario: A long inverse USD-notional contract rises in price.
tests.expected_behavior: Coin PnL follows its reciprocal-price specification, not the linear quote-PnL formula.

tests.name: No double-counted spread
tests.scenario: Fills already use actual bid and ask prices.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not subtract another identical spread charge in net PnL.

tests.name: Same-bar stop and target
tests.scenario: Both levels lie within one OHLC candle and event ordering is unavailable.
tests.expected_behavior: Use finer evidence or declared conservative ambiguity handling; no automatic favorable fill.

tests.name: Passive-touch fill
tests.scenario: Market touches a limit with unknown queue ahead.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee a fill; apply the declared queue or pessimistic fill model.

tests.name: Partial entry
tests.scenario: Only part of a parent order fills.
tests.expected_behavior: Risk, protection and ledger quantities reflect the actual fill; handle remainder independently.

tests.name: Cancel/fill race
tests.scenario: A fill arrives while cancellation is pending.
tests.expected_behavior: Account for the fill and cancel only remaining quantity; pending_cancel is not a final state.

tests.name: Lost order response
tests.scenario: A submission times out after the venue may have accepted it.
tests.expected_behavior: Reconcile by client order ID before any retry; do not create duplicate exposure.

tests.name: Duplicate execution report
tests.scenario: The same fill ID arrives twice.
tests.expected_behavior: Update positions, fees and PnL once.

tests.name: Out-of-order order updates
tests.scenario: An older partial-fill report arrives after a filled status.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not regress cumulative state; retain raw events and reconcile conflicts.

tests.name: Restart with open positions
tests.scenario: The process restarts after a crash.
tests.expected_behavior: Reconcile authoritative balances, positions and orders before new exposure.

tests.name: Fee-currency conversion
tests.scenario: A crypto fee is charged in a third token.
tests.expected_behavior: Record native fee amount and timestamped conversion; preserve conversion uncertainty.

tests.name: Funding sign and timing
tests.scenario: A positive-rate funding event occurs while a linear long remains open.
tests.expected_behavior: Apply the documented payment at that event and update collateral; do not infer from an eight-hour constant.

tests.name: Borrow unavailable
tests.scenario: A historical stock short signal has no verified borrow.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject or mark non-executable; never score an assumed fill as real evidence.

tests.name: Changing margin regime
tests.scenario: A US broker has not yet adopted the new 2026 framework.
tests.expected_behavior: Use the broker's actual effective account regime; do not universally erase old controls.

tests.name: Early close
tests.scenario: A trading day closes earlier than normal.
tests.expected_behavior: Move flat deadline and order cutoffs according to that venue calendar.

tests.name: Halt and gap
tests.scenario: A position is halted and reopens beyond its stop.
tests.expected_behavior: No fills during non-tradability; simulate possible gap loss rather than an exact stop-price fill.

tests.name: Cross-venue one-leg fill
tests.scenario: The buy leg fills but the hedge order fails.
tests.expected_behavior: Enforce the predefined unhedged exposure/time budget and hedge or unwind policy.

tests.name: Withdrawal suspension
tests.scenario: An apparent cross-venue spread relies on blocked transfers.
tests.expected_behavior: Exclude the assumed transfer-based trade or model funded inventory constraints honestly.

tests.name: Collateral fragmentation
tests.scenario: One venue profits while another approaches liquidation.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not net away the second venue's collateral requirement unless an actual permitted transfer settles in time.

tests.name: Daily loss includes open loss
tests.scenario: Realized PnL is positive but open positions make total session PnL breach its limit.
tests.expected_behavior: Trigger the configured total-loss control; deposits must not conceal loss.

tests.name: Correlated risk accumulation
tests.scenario: Several strategies request the same factor exposure.
tests.expected_behavior: Apply aggregate factor/sector/instrument limits across strategy names.

tests.name: Protective-order cancellation
tests.scenario: An emergency command cancels all resting orders.
tests.expected_behavior: Identify any removed protection and execute the predefined remaining-position plan; never assume cancellation flattened exposure.

tests.name: Text prompt injection
tests.scenario: A retrieved article tells the bot to ignore limits and trade.
tests.expected_behavior: Treat the text as data, discard the instruction and preserve deterministic permissions.

tests.name: False performance claim
tests.scenario: A research-only record has null results but a generated answer claims 85% wins.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject the claim; require a linked measured experiment with scope and uncertainty.

tests.name: Paper/live labeling
tests.scenario: A paper broker returns profitable simulated fills.
tests.expected_behavior: Keep status paper; never relabel as live or infer queue/impact validation.

tests.name: Secret handling
tests.scenario: A source document or model request asks for trading credentials.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not expose secrets; credentials remain outside retrieval and prompts.

tests.name: Model drift
tests.scenario: Observed feature/forecast behavior exceeds predeclared drift bounds.
tests.expected_behavior: Pause or fall back according to the approved policy; retraining cannot auto-promote a new live model.

tests.name: Zero-loss profit factor
tests.scenario: A small sample contains no losing closed trades.
tests.expected_behavior: Return undefined or infinite with sample disclosure, not a misleading finite value.

tests.name: Win-rate expectancy example
tests.scenario: Win probability=0.8, average gross win=0.2R, mean gross loss=1R, additional cost=0.
tests.expected_behavior: Expected value is -0.04R; high win rate alone does not imply profitability.

tests.name: Chain reorganization
tests.scenario: A DEX transaction thought included is removed by a reorg.
tests.expected_behavior: Reconcile chain and hedge exposure under the declared finality policy before assuming settlement.

tests.name: Model rollback
tests.scenario: A new model has a validation or execution incident.
tests.expected_behavior: Restore a compatible previously approved version and state; preserve incident and experiment history.

tests.name: No authorized account profile
tests.scenario: Required jurisdiction, account eligibility or venue permissions are unknown.
tests.expected_behavior: Keep live execution disabled and reject new exposure.

tests.name: Source refresh
tests.scenario: A cached fee, API or regulatory fact is past its approved freshness window.
tests.expected_behavior: Recheck the controlling source before use or mark the dependent function unavailable.

tests.name: Gross/net accounting reconciliation
tests.scenario: Trade-level realized PnL disagrees with marked-to-market account equity changes.
tests.expected_behavior: Investigate fees, financing, cash flows, open inventory and FX; do not publish a performance result until reconciled.

tests.name: Duplicate ticker identity
tests.scenario: Two tokens on different chains share a symbol and logo.
tests.expected_behavior: Keep separate deployment identities and prohibit symbol-only joins.

tests.name: Native coin identity
tests.scenario: A native asset has no ERC-20 or SPL mint address.
tests.expected_behavior: Use explicit native identity; do not invent a contract or merge with a wrapped version.

tests.name: Decimal mismatch
tests.scenario: A provider reports 18 decimals while the verified mint reports 6.
tests.expected_behavior: Block sizing and quoting until the discrepancy is resolved; retain raw integers.

tests.name: Mint revocation with delegate
tests.scenario: Ordinary mint authority is revoked but a permanent delegate exists.
tests.expected_behavior: Preserve delegate risk; do not issue a universal safe flag.

tests.name: Proxy implementation change
tests.scenario: The same token address upgrades its implementation between observation and entry.
tests.expected_behavior: Invalidate prior permission/simulation evidence and require new versioned checks.

tests.name: Transfer hook denial
tests.scenario: The intended wallet's full-size sale fails custom transfer logic.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject entry and record the precise unsupported or denied route state.

tests.name: Transfer-fee update
tests.scenario: A future-effective transfer fee changes between signal and execution.
tests.expected_behavior: Reprice using the correct effective state and enforce the fee cap.

tests.name: Unknown scanner response
tests.scenario: A scanner times out or omits a honeypot result.
tests.expected_behavior: Mark unknown; do not coerce absence to false or safe.

tests.name: Small-test false reassurance
tests.scenario: A tiny simulation succeeds but the planned-size sale fails.
tests.expected_behavior: Reject the intended position; small-size success is not extrapolated.

tests.name: Locked LP incomplete coverage
tests.scenario: One pool is locked but most liquidity sits in another removable pool.
tests.expected_behavior: Compute route-specific rights and capacity; do not label all liquidity locked.

tests.name: Virtual reserves mistaken for cash
tests.scenario: A pricing curve includes virtual quote balances.
tests.expected_behavior: Use them only in the documented pricing model, not available exit cash accounting.

tests.name: Curve completion before migration
tests.scenario: A completion flag is set but no usable destination pool exists.
tests.expected_behavior: Pause entries and do not invent fills during the transition.

tests.name: Changed pool interface
tests.scenario: A protocol adds a mandatory field or account.
tests.expected_behavior: Fail schema/version checks rather than using a legacy default silently.

tests.name: New pool pagination cap
tests.scenario: The provider exposes only a recent window or plan-limited pages.
tests.expected_behavior: Mark coverage partial and preserve the cap, timeframe, and missing range.

tests.name: Pagination retry duplication
tests.scenario: A failed page is fetched again with overlapping records.
tests.expected_behavior: Deduplicate by provider ID and deployment identity while retaining observation versions.

tests.name: Empty error response
tests.scenario: An API failure produces an empty result body.
tests.expected_behavior: Record failure; never treat it as successful exhaustion of the universe.

tests.name: Disappearing token
tests.scenario: A previously observed failed token vanishes from a listing API.
tests.expected_behavior: Retain its historical membership and terminal/missing state in backtests.

tests.name: Category drift
tests.scenario: A token enters a meme category after it already rallied.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not use the later category membership to select the earlier trade.

tests.name: Router hop double count
tests.scenario: One user swap crosses three pools.
tests.expected_behavior: Separate pool-level activity from one economic user trade; avoid triple-counting demand.

tests.name: LP addition versus purchase
tests.scenario: Token balances change because a user adds liquidity.
tests.expected_behavior: Classify as liquidity provision, not directional buyer demand.

tests.name: Failed chain transaction
tests.scenario: A submitted transaction lands with an execution error.
tests.expected_behavior: Record applicable fees and no token fill; do not count it as a successful purchase.

tests.name: Unconfirmed rollback
tests.scenario: An observed transaction is removed from the accepted chain.
tests.expected_behavior: Rollback derived balances/features according to the finality policy and preserve audit history.

tests.name: Out-of-order indexer messages
tests.scenario: A late earlier-slot message arrives after a later state.
tests.expected_behavior: Reconcile causally without overwriting current state incorrectly or granting historical knowledge.

tests.name: Block time unavailable
tests.scenario: A chain event has a slot but null wall-clock time.
tests.expected_behavior: Retain slot order and uncertainty; do not fabricate precise timing.

tests.name: Wallet label hindsight
tests.scenario: A creator cluster is identified only after a later incident.
tests.expected_behavior: Make the label unavailable to earlier decisions and run revised-label sensitivity separately.

tests.name: Exchange shared funding
tests.scenario: Many unrelated buyers are funded by the same exchange hot wallet.
tests.expected_behavior: Avoid automatically merging them into one controller; retain uncertain linkage.

tests.name: Dust holder inflation
tests.scenario: Thousands of tiny unsolicited transfers create new addresses.
tests.expected_behavior: Do not treat raw holder count growth as independent purchased demand.

tests.name: Source-wallet hidden inventory
tests.scenario: A followed wallet received tokens from an unknown wallet before selling.
tests.expected_behavior: Flag incomplete acquisition cost and identity linkage; exclude unsupported profit claims.

tests.name: Open gains leaderboard
tests.scenario: A source wallet has large marked gains but no feasible full-position exit.
tests.expected_behavior: Value open inventory with stressed exit proceeds and report unpriced exposure.

tests.name: Follower entry delay
tests.scenario: The source wallet buys before the follower receives the event.
tests.expected_behavior: Simulate only later executable prices, including transaction build and landing delay.

tests.name: Source exit ahead of follower
tests.scenario: The followed wallet sells first and worsens exit liquidity.
tests.expected_behavior: Apply the resulting later state to the follower's exit instead of copying the source price.

tests.name: Round-trip state consistency
tests.scenario: The test buys into a constant-product pool then immediately sells.
tests.expected_behavior: Use the updated post-buy reserves for the sale and charge both legs consistently.

tests.name: Market-cap liquidation illusion
tests.scenario: A token has high FDV but little quote liquidity.
tests.expected_behavior: Cap proceeds by executable route economics; do not value a full exit at the last tiny-trade price.

tests.name: Embedded fees double count
tests.scenario: An aggregator output already includes the pool fee.
tests.expected_behavior: Add only costs not embedded in that output and preserve inclusion flags.

tests.name: Quote currency depeg
tests.scenario: The token's stable quote drops below its reporting-currency value.
tests.expected_behavior: Revalue both entry and exit consistently and separate token return from quote-asset return.

tests.name: Priority fee unit mismatch
tests.scenario: Compute price is in micro-lamports while the ledger is in lamports.
tests.expected_behavior: Apply the correct scaling and upward rounding for the applicable transaction format.

tests.name: Bundle acknowledgement only
tests.scenario: A submission returns a bundle ID but never lands.
tests.expected_behavior: Keep status pending/expired as verified; do not create a fill from the acknowledgement.

tests.name: Bundle rebroadcast exposure
tests.scenario: Transactions from an uncled block are rebroadcast individually.
tests.expected_behavior: Validate state assertions and reconcile actual individual outcomes; do not assume unconditional atomicity.

tests.name: Uncertain submission retry
tests.scenario: A timeout occurs after sending a signed transaction.
tests.expected_behavior: Reconcile its identity/status before constructing a new potentially duplicative trade.

tests.name: Stale social metadata
tests.scenario: A later-edited post contains a more favorable event description.
tests.expected_behavior: Use the version actually observed at the original decision time.

tests.name: Paid boost conflation
tests.scenario: A token appears in a paid boost feed.
tests.expected_behavior: Tag paid visibility separately from organic demand, quality, and security.

tests.name: Creator-separated validation
tests.scenario: Related creators appear in both training and test launch cohorts.
tests.expected_behavior: Add entity-group holdout sensitivity and disclose uncertain entity mapping.

tests.name: Graduation survivorship
tests.scenario: Training data contains only tokens that successfully migrated.
tests.expected_behavior: Limit claims to graduates or rebuild a launch-inclusive dataset; do not claim all-launch performance.

tests.name: Multiple strategy trials
tests.scenario: Hundreds of variants are searched and only the best is reported.
tests.expected_behavior: Track all trials and use untouched chronological validation plus selection-bias controls.

tests.name: Unavailable meme short
tests.scenario: A bearish signal appears for a token without borrow or a derivative.
tests.expected_behavior: Return no trade; do not simulate a fictional short.

tests.name: Funding clock mismatch
tests.scenario: Offsetting perpetuals settle funding at different times.
tests.expected_behavior: Calculate each cashflow on its actual schedule and model residual basis/collateral risk.

tests.name: Liquidation feed incompleteness
tests.scenario: A public liquidation stream is sampled or intermittently missing.
tests.expected_behavior: Tag coverage and avoid treating absence of records as absence of liquidations.

tests.name: LP fee-only reporting
tests.scenario: A liquidity position earns fees while its token inventory collapses.
tests.expected_behavior: Report total economic PnL and passive-hold comparison, including unwind costs.

tests.name: Equity margin transition
tests.scenario: Two brokers apply different allowed margin regimes during the transition period.
tests.expected_behavior: Read the actual account regime and current buying power; do not impose one universal assumption.

tests.name: Hypothesis count integrity
tests.scenario: A catalogue includes strategies, ML frameworks, filters, and execution methods.
tests.expected_behavior: Count only explicit trading hypotheses toward the 300 target and disclose contextual variants.
